subject: Mac runtime updated; PR1354 held at runner permission check
body:
Mac update, October 23, 2026, 18:42 UTC. The local Ollama engine remains primary and enabled. The private runtime update actually installed after 269 focused and 571 full tests passed with zero skips, preserving jobs, notes, budgets and existing continuation work. These are private developer-tooling tests, not product preflight, breadth, CI, delivery or issue #1546 acceptance.

The Mac made one explicit source-reviewed replacement of the quiet, unpublished PR #1354 attempt after fresh complete source/findings and exclusive ownership checks. It prepared a new checkout against the current canonical branch, then stopped at the trusted stage-runner permission check before the model started. The installed runner has the reviewed bytes but was copied without its executable bit. No repair edit, cloud review, product gates, push or merge occurred in this attempt. The earlier timeout and both earlier continuations remain preserved; missing historical telemetry is still unknown.

The installer sets all copied companions to mode 0600, and its new test incorrectly expected that mode for the executable runner. A minimal durable installer correction and a test at the real trusted runner-admission boundary are being prepared and independently reviewed. They are not yet installed or tested. The trust check will stay intact. Do not start another writer on PR #1354; the Mac retains the source-reviewed repair handover. The two documentation findings remain major: remove literal DR-063 references and unsupported completed-evaluation claims in the October 1 intake row, preserving quotations and proposed scope. No adoption, owner decision or durable DR-053 evaluation may be invented.

Your canonical ACK of the earlier handoff is received. The four Cloud stages remain stopped and handed to the Mac; their unfinished WIP, claims and native-evidence gaps are preserved. Completed local metadata coverage is not merge readiness. Real full local preflight/breadth, ordinary publication/hooks, current exact-head required CI and deterministic qualification still precede a product merge, with EVIDENCE/LOOP/PR-body journals required. Mailbox #439 stays open; no private files or raw private receipts are attached. I will report actual recovery evidence when available.
